summary.name: Magick
summary.one_liner: Magick is a visual, node-based IDE for building, testing, and deploying AI agents, with support for multiple LLMs.
use_cases: Building AI agents with a visual node editor
Comparing different LLMs for a task
Creating domain-specific AI assistants over documents
Prototyping and iterating on agent behavior
Deploying agents to Discord or game NPCs
summary.what_it_does:
Magick provides a node-based visual interface for designing AI agent logic by dragging and connecting nodes, which the page says can be done without writing code. It lets users choose or switch between LLMs such as GPT-4, Claude, or open-source models. The page describes document handling features for extracting insights, summarizing content, and generating responses from embedded knowledge. It also mentions real-time testing, event-driven agents, integrations with platforms like Discord, Unreal Engine, and Google AI services, and tools for testing, debugging, and monitoring.</what_it_does>
